# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform stability and efficiency**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 strengthens platform support while removing allocation and lifetime pitfalls across managed and native code. Apple deployment baselines advance, browser WebGPU builds move their C++ support into the packaged native archive, and Android continuous rendering follows the display clock. Linux HarfBuzz integration is more robust when applications also load system HarfBuzz.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **String data creation is bounds-safe** — SKData creation from a C string no longer reads beyond the native buffer and writes directly into SKData. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Front-buffered streams release their retained source** — Disposing a front-buffered managed stream now releases the wrapped stream instead of retaining it. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Android texture rendering follows the display clock** — Automatic continuous frames for Android GL texture views are paced by display refresh callbacks, avoiding redraws driven by buffer-swap throughput while preserving explicit render requests. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Linux HarfBuzz stays within the bundled library** — The Linux native library binds its internal HarfBuzz function calls locally, preventing conflicts with a system HarfBuzz library loaded by another framework such as GTK. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed pixel copies avoid an intermediate allocation** — Valid managed pixel buffers can now be copied directly into raster images, reducing allocation overhead without changing validation behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **HarfBuzz text processing allocates less** — UTF-32 buffer encoding and feature-string conversion reuse stack or pooled storage, reducing transient allocations while preserving existing shaping and decoding behavior. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Apple native package baselines are updated** — The native libraries now require macOS 11.0 and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 14.0; applications targeting older operating-system versions must remain on an earlier SkiaSharp release. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **Browser WebGPU C++ support ships inside the native archive** — WebGPU-enabled browser applications no longer compile emdawnwebgpu C++ source during their final link, avoiding C++ flags on application C sources while retaining the required JavaScript glue. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
